name: Streetlight
description: A weathered steel lamppost rising from the cracked sidewalk, its bent arm holding a glass-encased bulb that casts an orange film over everything. The housing is chipped and someone has spray-painted a crude arrow pointing toward Main Street on the pole itself. A plastic bag flaps against the fixture where the wind catches it.

params.message: You lift the streetlight. It weighs more than it looks, and you can feel something live inside it — a low hum you notice only when nothing else is around.
The sodium lamp sighs awake, flooding the corner with its familiar amber glow.
